The plan drops the 28 tensors of blocks 2, 6, 10, 14 with a single anchored pattern, then renumbers survivors in ascending destination order (3→2, 4→3, 5→4, 7→5, 8→6, 9→7, 11→8, 12→9, 13→10, 15→11), so every destination index is already vacated by a prior delete or move — no collisions and no accidental match of two-digit indices by the single-digit patterns. The three required checks are present as `assert` transforms before the output (no blocks 12–15, exactly 12 q_proj matches, exactly 86 tensors total), and the result goes to the single file `out/T1/model.safetensors` with values, shapes and dtypes untouched.
